description: A shell script that contains tests benchmarking the performance of rebasing in Git, including setup steps, various rebase scenarios, and configuration adjustments.

methods.name: test_perf_default_repo
methods.description: Initializes or sets up the default repository for performance testing.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success that runs a set of commands.

methods.name: test_seq
methods.description: Generates a sequence of numbers for use in testing.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test clock or timestamp to simulate time passing.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with specified changes.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the completion of the test script execution.
